text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No... footsteps, right? Yeah.
Alright, at this rate—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah! H-Hello, Trainer-san~.
U-Umm, well, you see, this is—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Mirako-o-o! Where are you-u-u!
Give it up and stop! Mira-ko-o-o!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're here already?!
W-Well, time for more training, I guess~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*pitter-patter-patter...*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I watched Hishi Miracle move away in a hurry, yet maintaining the steady pace of a true stayer.
However, even after that—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Hm? Who's that over there...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: M-Meooww.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ummm... Mirako-chan?
It's kind of awkward to say, but I think your ears are completely visible.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
! Hishi Miracle, you're here!?
You won't get away this time...!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Gyaah! Can't you please do something about it~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Today, I spotted Hishi Miracle running away from "something" all over the place.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Waaah, you traitorrr!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"And after you said you'd give me an alibi~!
Where did our friendship go~~?!"

text_block_list.name: Friend A
text_block_list.text: It's precisely because we're friends~.

text_block_list.name: Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Come on, give it up already.
I won't do ya wrong, so—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For someone who takes everything "in moderation,"
seeing her this desperate is unusual.
I'd like to at least hear her out, but...

text_block_list.name: Friend A
text_block_list.text: No, no, Trainer. The thing is—

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, everyone in the pool.
"Practical Swimming Test"—ready... *tweet*!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: *gurgle gurgle... Pffft!*

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Glub glub... *splutter*!
choice_data_list: So this is what you didn't want...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Man, great teamwork, good job!
If we couldn't take this test,
our training would've been restricted!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It would have meant taking supplementary classes.
That is why I chased after it with all my might.
choice_data_list: So that's how it was... Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Mirako-o-o! Just a little further!
Keep at it-t-t!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I know that you can accomplish this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Hishi Miracle practically drifted her way through, but somehow managed to swim the passing 25-meter mark!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: *wheeze*... *wheeze*...
choice_data_list: Hishi Miracle, great work out there—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Next time, I'll definitely run away with the lead...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Starting with this pool test!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Stunned by Hishi Miracle's unusual surge of motivation—
choice_data_list: In that case, let's learn more about it and overcome it!
If only that motivation went toward swimming...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I understand wanting to avoid things you're not good at.
At times like that, dispelling that aversion
with knowledge is one way to go.
choice_data_list: Next time, let's start with classroom learning!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, starting with theory~?
I'm not really the type to learn through theory, but...
choice_data_list: It's fine! You can do it!
It's fine! You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: "No, no! I won't fall for that trick every single time, you know~!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Even if you say that,
there's absolutely nothing in it for me~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No matter how hard I try, I don't get any better,
and because I'm bad at it, it just wears me out even more...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Drying both my tail and hair is such a pain, and getting water up my nose hurts too...
choice_data_list: Well, I guess that makes sense...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's a reason behind every weakness.
Even so, I can't just tell her, "Well then, you don't have to swim"—
choice_data_list: Let's go get something yummy on the days we go swimming!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Is it something yummy~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I suggest that whatever she wants is fine—
a sweets buffet, sushi, yakiniku, or even okonomiyaki.
choice_data_list: Let's do our best and make even one good thing happen.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I guess that might give me
a little bit of motivation... maybe?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...For now, if that's valid starting today,
I might want to go eat a ton of yakiniku.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we went out for yakiniku that day...
Afterward, with that "reward" fueling her,
Hishi Miracle somehow managed to endure pool class.
